question: What identity does the weapon-mantra Aiṃ bear as dissolution fire, O Śivā?
premises: The syllable aiṃ is named as the weapon-mantra.
It is known as the fire of dissolution.
It is characterized as a great flame.
inference: The weapon-mantra aiṃ is recognized as the great-flamed fire of dissolution.
plain_english: O Śivā, aiṃ is known as the weapon-mantra, the great-flamed fire of dissolution.
